[[File:GEMP LOTR play.lotrtcgpc.net login.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Lord of the Rings TCG GEMP login, 2026]]

'''GEMP''' (from Gempukku) is a browser rules engine for customizable card games with server-adjudicated play.<ref name="lotrreadme" /><ref name="historyvid" /> [[Marcin Sciesinski]] created it in 2011.<ref name="t7301" /><ref name="ghname" /><ref name="historyvid" /> The first public table was for [[The Lord of the Rings Trading Card Game]].<ref name="t7476" /> [[Troy Biesterfeld]] forked Star Wars CCG from GEMP in 2013.<ref name="t52222" /> The [[Players Committee]] hosts a Star Wars CCG table at gemp.starwarsccg.org.<ref name="pcgemp" /><ref name="pcpublic" /> The table at play.swccg.com is an independent table that descends from a copy of the Players Committee GEMP.<ref name="readme" /><ref name="billcopy" /><ref name="historyvid" />

Players used [[Holotable]] for online play before GEMP.

== Name ==

GEMP is short for Gempukku, the coming-of-age ceremony in ''Legend of the Five Rings''.<ref name="historyvid" /><ref name="t7301" /> The name is a play on Apprentice, a ''Magic: The Gathering'' online client.<ref name="historyvid" />

== Origin ==

On 9 August 2011, Sciesinski proposed a browser client for The Lord of the Rings TCG on the Last Homely House forums.<ref name="t7301" /> He had written the first client for playing Legend of the Five Rings online, named Gempukku.<ref name="t7301" /> The first public beta of Gemp-LotR opened on 17 September 2011 at gempukku.com/gemp-lotr.<ref name="t7476" />

== Lord of the Rings TCG ==

LOTR TCG GEMP is hosted by the Player's Council at play.lotrtcgpc.net.<ref name="lotrreadme" /><ref name="lotrhome" /> [[Christian McCarty]] is the maintainer of LOTR TCG GEMP.<ref name="teltura" /><ref name="lotrreadme" /> The Player's Council About page says the Star Wars Players Committee uses the same software.<ref name="lotrabout" />

== Star Wars CCG ==

=== Players Committee GEMP ===

On 29 August 2013, Biesterfeld posted that he had started a project based on Gemp-LotR for Star Wars CCG.<ref name="t52222" /> The first table ran at tlbiesterfeld.servegame.com/gemp-swccg.<ref name="t52222" /> In June 2018 he stepped away, and the Players Committee took over management.<ref name="gemp2018" /> The Players Committee table is at gemp.starwarsccg.org/gemp-swccg/.<ref name="pcgemp" /> On 1 September 2020 the Players Committee announced that GEMP source code was on GitHub.<ref name="t76260" /><ref name="pcpublic" /> On 1 February 2021 the Players Committee released a new GEMP user interface publicly, and early on 6 April 2021 GEMP reached its 250,000th game played.<ref name="slack-gemp-2021">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 1 February 2021 (“Today is the day many have been eagerly anticipating: the public release of the new GEMP user interface!”) and 6 April 2021 (“Early on April 6th, GEMP reached its 250,000th game played.”).</ref> In September 2021, GEMP set a monthly record with 7,806 games played (surpassing April 2020's 7,425), and on 22 November 2021 GEMP reached its 300,000th game played with more than 5,150 unique users.<ref name="slack-gemp-2021b">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 1 October 2021 (“September 2021 was a record setting month on GEMP with 7806 games played. Previous high was 7425 games in April 2020.”) and 22 November 2021 (“GEMP reached its 300,000th game played! With over 5,150 unique users.”).</ref> On 28 February 2023, GEMP reached its 400,000th game played.<ref name="slack-gemp-400k">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Scott Lingrell (Scott) / Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 28 February 2023: “Today, GEMP reached its 400,000th game played.”</ref> On 28 August 2023, the Players Committee marked GEMP's 10th birthday, thanking [[Troy Biesterfeld]] as well as [[Jeremy DiPaolo]], “Echo Base Trooper”, and the GEMP slicers.<ref name="slack-gemp-10yr">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Jared Napolitano (JaredNap) and Hayes Hunter (hayes), 28 August 2023: “Today is GEMP’s 10th Birthday. Go crazy everybody! Thanks to @tbiesty for this monumental endeavor for SWCCG.” / “also thanks to @Echo Base Trooper , @Jeremy DiPaolo and all of the slicers for their work since the baton was passed.”</ref> On 2 August 2024, the Players Committee announced <code>500K</code> Open and Retro-PDS2 leagues marking GEMP's 500,000th game milestone, and on 5 September 2024 added Series 4 Alternate Image Booster Packs to the GEMP Merchant.<ref name="slack-gemp-500k">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, [[Jared Napolitano]] (JaredNap), 2 August 2024 (“GEMP 500K Open & Retro-PDS2 Leagues kick off tomorrow.”) and 5 September 2024 (“Series 4 GEMP Alternate Image Booster Packs are now available for purchase in the GEMP Merchant”).</ref> In late September and early October 2024, two interface updates launched: [[Charlie Arlandson]] (<code>GoldenGod</code>) added a deckbuilder button to populate all Defensive Shields (including the Light Side Mythrol) into a deck, and [[Christian McCarty]] (<code>ketura</code>) ported auto-zoom on card hover from LOTR GEMP (with Shift flipping objectives and rotating opponent locations 180 degrees).<ref name="slack-gemp-ui24">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, [[James Martin]] (solidsnck), 29 September 2024 (“@GoldenGod worked in a new feature to GEMP to add all shields (including the mythrol for light) to your decks in the deckbuilder”), and "jetsaredim", 2 October 2024 (“Through the generous efforts of @ketura, the auto-zoom on hover feature from LotR gemp has been added to SWCCG gemp in both the main game screen as well as the deck builder.”).</ref> Later GEMP card-pool updates included [[Virtual Set 25]] preview cards (14 April 2025) and full release (7–8 August 2025), [[Virtual Set 26]] (7–8 December 2025) and the 26 December 2025 ''Hidden Path'' errata patch, [[Tweak Set]] 2026 (8–9 March 2026), May 2026 errata (10 May 2026), and [[Virtual Set 27]] preview cards (24 August 2026) followed by a 7 September 2026 errata update to ''This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time (V)''.<ref name="slack-gemp-2526">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, [[Greg Zinn]] (Gergall), "darkjediknight11", and [[Chris Kelly]] (DesignAdvocate), April 2025 – September 2026 (#2038–#2042, #2070–#2075, #2122–#2124, #2135–#2136, #2179–#2183, #2214, #2242, #2246).</ref>

=== play.swccg.com ===

play.swccg.com is an independent Star Wars CCG table.<ref name="play" /><ref name="readme" /> It descends from a copy of the Players Committee GEMP.<ref name="billcopy" /><ref name="readme" /> Championship tables load Decipher and Players Committee cards. Fan products stay in isolated formats; see [[Custom formats]]. Planned work, including further [[Anything Goes]] rules and a [[True Sabacc]] game mode, is listed on [[GEMP planned features]].
